comment: The relationship is described as bidirectional because terminology changes can affect models. The inverse impact is also important: information-model changes may require new value sets, new concepts, revised mappings, or terminology requests.

public.text: The relationship is described as bidirectional because terminology changes can affect models. The inverse impact is also important: information-model changes may require new value sets, new concepts, revised mappings, or terminology requests.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe dependency and change-impact analysis in both directions and require coordinated release planning, compatibility assessment, and notification.
